entities.summary: Amshuman is a king of the Suryavamsha dynasty in Hinduism. The son of Asamanjasa, Amshuman becomes the king of Ayodhya after the death of his grandfather, King Sagara. Amshuman's grandson, Bhagiratha, brings the flow of the Ganges down from heaven. Amshuman was a monarchs & rulers from Ayodhya. Recognized as a landmark figure with global significance (referenced in 0 Wikipedia editions). Relevant to political systems and imperial and colonial studies.
